alt: On May 27, 2026, Nicolas Hernandez (CalAudit.org) sent an email to Tracfone Executive Resolution rejecting their policy boilerplate as non-responsive to FCC Complaint #8711384 regarding a hardware-restricted device (CID 0x0033) despite being carrier-unlocked.
full_text:
From: Nicolas Hernandez (CalAudit.org)
Sent: Wednesday, May 27, 2026
To: Tracfone Executive Resolution
Subject: RE: FCC Complaint #8711384 - Technical Rebuttal

I am rejecting the provided policy boilerplate as non-responsive to the technical facts. The device remains hardware-restricted (CID 0x0033) despite being carrier-unlocked...
summary: On May 27, 2026, Nicolas Hernandez (CalAudit.org) sent an email to Tracfone Executive Resolution rejecting their policy boilerplate as non-responsive to FCC Complaint #8711384 regarding a hardware-restricted device (CID 0x0033) despite being carrier-unlocked.
